source: OpenStreetMap named tower footprint, independently identified against National Inventory NICPMI 1384 and custodian photographs
identityStatus: Manual corroboration of named tower; the footprint has no Wikidata tag
axis: Native +X follows the first footprint edge southeast; +Z is inland southwest and -Z is seaward northeast. The raised door faces inland and the opposite window faces the coast.
limitations: Horizontal plan is mapped. Vertical intervals are photographic reconstructions, not a measured elevation survey.
